extraction.Name: Grover Cleveland Scissons
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 30, 1921 by the Gregory County Abstract Company
extraction.Buyer: Mortgage dated November 8, 1922, by Scissons to J. P. Treiweiler for $1700 due May 8, 1923. Foreclosure sale dated February 9, 1929, to Treiweiler for $1800.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739676 issued. No receipt. Land described as North half of Southeast quarter and North half of Southwest quarter, Section 33, township 97, north of range 69. Redemption period will expire February 9, 1930. Document dated June 1929.
